$comment: INTERIM CONTRACT — not present in rabbitqa_spec_v1.1.0.md. The technical spec references ConstraintReport.schema.json in §2.4 (GraphChangeSet.constraint_report) and §5.6 (POST /v1/graph/changesets/{id}/validate response) but never defines its fields. This schema is derived by directly mirroring ValidationReport.schema.json's checks/overall_status shape and enumerating exactly the six named cardinality/ontology rules stated in §2.4's prose. It MUST be confirmed against a spec update (bumping spec_version per §0's change policy) before being treated as final — do not extend or fork it silently.

rule_name.description: One entry per §2.4 cardinality rule / §3.2 relationship-table conformance check

overall_status.description: Any single rule fail forces overall_status = fail, which per §2.4 forces GraphChangeSet.status = rejected
